# StartupX

StartupX is a Canadian recruiting partner for Seed to Series A startups. StartupX
works directly with founders and revenue leaders to fill go-to-market and revenue
roles, and delivers a small shortlist of vetted candidates rather than a high
volume of applicants.

## Services

StartupX recruits primarily for GTM and revenue roles, including Account Executive,
Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative, Inside Sales,
Revenue Operations, GTM Lead, Account Management, Partnerships, and Business
Development.

StartupX also supports select Customer Success, Customer Support Lead, Operations
and Systems, founder-adjacent, and early-stage operations roles.

## Hiring model

Success-fee recruiting. Clients pay only when a hire starts — there is no retainer
and no upfront fee. StartupX targets 2–3 vetted candidates and a shortlist within
approximately 10 days of the discovery call. Every candidate is screened for both
startup readiness and role-specific capability.

## Who StartupX serves

Seed to Series A startups that have a product, early customers, and a team that
needs to grow, whose founders and revenue leaders do not have the bandwidth to run
a search themselves.

## Primary markets

Toronto
Montreal
Vancouver
Canada
